commits.message: require a repository secret that was never set
commits.author: cipoklean

files.patch:
@@ -16,3 +16,14 @@ jobs:
         run: python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
       - name: test
         run: python -m pytest -q
+      - name: publish
+        env:
+          LAB_TOKEN=[REDACTED] secrets.LAB_MISSING_TOKEN }}
+        run: |
+          python - <<'PY'
+          import os
+          import sys
+
+          if not os.environ.get("LAB_TOKEN"):
+              sys.exit("refusing to publish: required secret LAB_TOKEN is empty")
+          PY
